description: One table for every copy of the rule that recognises a Xiaohongshu block. Each copy is tested only against the cases of the context it reads; inside one context the expected answer is the same for every case that shares a text. The same sentence can be a block in one context and ordinary content in another, which is why the table says why.

failure-output.read_by: Python: platform_access.SAFETY_SIGNAL, used by the detail fetcher, the media downloader and the DianDian page check
failure-output.input: What a request that produced no usable note left behind: the page text, the process output, the exception message.

diagnostic-output.input: The process output of a request that DID return a note. The note may talk about anything, so only a structured block code counts.

page-shell.input: Text of a visible alert or dialog on a board page. Board pages carry note text, so only a line shaped like the platform's own prompt counts.

page-script.read_by: Userscript: STRUCTURED_SAFETY_CODE, and the bridge's injected page check
page-script.input: Text of a JSON script element in the page. Only a block code under a status or error key counts, never words inside note content.

dialog-text.read_by: Bridge: the page check injected before the share step (platform_access.injected_page_check_js)
dialog-text.input: Text of a visible alert or dialog on a note page the share step opened itself. Any block word in it stops the step.

cases.text: 这个工具可以自动识别验证码
cases.why: A request that returned no note and whose page mentions a captcha is treated as blocked; the loose rule only runs when nothing usable came back.
A rate-limit status line in a failed request's output is the platform refusing the request.
The platform's own too-frequent prompt.
300031 is the platform's block code.
The platform asking for a verification step.
An English captcha prompt.
A rate-limit status code printed by the request layer.
A note that cannot be read is a gap, not a block.
429 as a number inside prose is not a status code.
429 as an episode number is not a status code.

cases.text: 这个工具可以自动识别验证码
cases.why: The note itself came back fine and may be about captchas; prose is not a block when a note was extracted.
A rate-limit status line in the diagnostics is structured evidence even when a note came back.
A prose prompt alone does not override a note that was extracted.
A structured block code counts whatever else came back.
A labelled block code counts whatever else came back.
429 as a number inside prose is not a status code.

cases.text: 这个工具可以自动识别验证码
cases.why: In a page that carries note text, a sentence about captchas is content; only a line shaped like the platform's prompt counts.
A protocol status line is not text the platform shows in a prompt; on a page it is note content or a technical aside.
The platform's own too-frequent prompt, shaped as a whole line.
The platform asking for a captcha, shaped as a whole line.
A prompt consisting only of the word.
The bare block code as a whole line.

cases.text: 新手教程：如何通过验证码
cases.why: A sentence that merely ends in the word is note content.
The block code under a code key.
The block code under a status key.
The digits inside a title are content; the code key says success.
A note describing the error code is not the platform raising it.

cases.text: 这个工具可以自动识别验证码
cases.why: The share step opens the note page itself, so a visible dialog that mentions a captcha is treated as the platform stopping it.
A protocol status line is not text the platform shows in a dialog.
The platform's own too-frequent prompt.
The block code shown in a dialog.
An ordinary share confirmation.
